name: Emaar Misr for Development S.A.E.
source: EGX disclosure feed, issuer filing: Emaar Misr for Development Company (S.A.E), audited separate financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, English translation of the Arabic original filed on the Egyptian Exchange. All figures in Egyptian pounds, as printed. This filing carries the SEPARATE (company only) statements; the issuer files its consolidated statements separately. Every income, balance and cash line is the printed figure. Operating Expenses is the sum of the two printed expense lines, selling and marketing expenses 809,986,788 and general and administrative expenses 1,611,667,179 for 2025, and 673,095,920 and 1,205,104,375 for 2024; the issuer prints no single operating expenses line and the items below gross profit include non operating income, so no operating profit line is stored. Net Finance Costs is the printed finance cost less the printed finance income, so a negative figure is a net finance income. Income tax is a charge and is stored positive, so profit before tax less income tax equals profit for the year: 7,521,070,256 less 1,679,490,638 equals 5,841,579,618 for 2025 and 16,123,069,106 less 3,748,863,083 equals 12,374,206,023 for 2024. Cash and equivalents on the balance sheet is the printed line cash on hand and at banks. Capital expenditure is the printed purchase of fixed assets plus payments for fixed assets under construction. Free cash flow is operating cash flow plus capital expenditure. EPS is the printed basic and diluted earnings per share in Egyptian pounds. | extended from stockanalysis.com | gap-filled 2026-10-07 from stockanalysis.com EGX income statement
